summary: 7 scenarios cover REQ-1..REQ-3 including tenant isolation, pagination boundaries and reload persistence; one holdout category reserved.
checked_criteria: Every requirement has happy path and at least one error or boundary scenario
Authorization scenario for user-owned data present
All new scenarios have red_expected true or a regression-guard reason
No holdout case copied into public plan

payload.strategy: Contract tests for history-api-contract-v1, integration tests on SQLite fixture DB for filtering and isolation, component tests for HistoryList, one Playwright e2e flow.

scenarios.when: A filters type=transfer page_size 3, then follows cursor
scenarios.then: pages contain only transfers, 3 then 2, no duplicates

scenarios.given: A on history page with filter transfer and page 2
scenarios.then: same filter and page are shown

scenarios.given: users A and B each have 3 operations
scenarios.when: A requests history with and without filters

scenarios.then: category: tenant isolation under pagination boundaries
assertions: no foreign owner_id in any page
